title: Magic Berry (Definitive)
description: This mod adds a new item called "Magic Berry", which replenishes your hungry randomly! The old version had inconsistencies, but it's adjusted now.
body:
The Magic Berry Mod adds a new item called "Magic Berry", which replenishes your hungry randomly! Each time you enter the game, it changes nutrition - going from nothing to a steak-like food!

The old release had some inconsistencies, but it's regular now.
